description: Simulates rapid canary document encryption in safe sandbox boundary.
businessImpact: Potential encryption and permanent loss of unbacked data assets.
detectionLogic: Heuristic canary file extension watcher detected burst write activity.
attackScript: mkdir C:\Astra\Demo\LockBit && echo Confidential Enterprise Q3 Financials > C:\Astra\Demo\LockBit\Financials.docx && explorer C:\Astra\Demo\LockBit && timeout 2 && ren C:\Astra\Demo\LockBit\*.docx *.lockbit
aiSummary: Autonomous AI detected LockBit 3.0 canary encryption behavior. Immediate containment verified.

description: Simulates adversary command-and-control beacon dropped into temporary staging.
businessImpact: Interactive remote adversary command shell on the corporate network.
detectionLogic: Network telemetry detected outbound loopback beaconing pattern.
attackScript: mkdir C:\Astra\Demo\Beacon && echo [COBALT-STRIKE-CONFIG] C2=127.0.0.1:44444 Sleep=5 > C:\Astra\Demo\Beacon\beacon.cfg && explorer C:\Astra\Demo\Beacon
aiSummary: Cobalt Strike listener configuration staged in user temp. Dispatched beacon quarantine.

description: Adversary attempts to elevate disabled Guest account into local Administrators.
businessImpact: Total endpoint administrative takeover and persistence establishment.
detectionLogic: AdministratorMonitor intercepted unauthorized membership change in Administrators group.
immediateAction: Revoke Local Admin Privileges & Disable Account
attackScript: net localgroup Administrators Guest /add && net user Guest /active:yes
aiSummary: Privilege escalation attempt intercepted. Rogue administrative grant automatically rolled back.

description: Injects malicious autorun registry entry in HKCU Software Microsoft Windows CurrentVersion Run.
businessImpact: Malware re-executes upon every user logon automatically.
detectionLogic: RegistryMonitor caught unauthorized creation of AstraRogue under Run key.
attackScript: reg add "HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run" /v AstraRogue /t REG_SZ /d "calc.exe" /f && start regedit
aiSummary: Autorun persistence hook eliminated from Windows registry baseline.

description: Appends unauthorized loopback DNS redirection into Windows hosts file.
businessImpact: Traffic to banking or corporate portals redirected to adversary proxy.
detectionLogic: HostsMonitor SHA-256 integrity check mismatch detected against baseline hash.
attackScript: powershell -Command "Add-Content -Path 'C:\Windows\System32\drivers\etc\hosts' -Value '127.0.0.1 astra-internal-bank.com' -Force" && notepad C:\Windows\System32\drivers\etc\hosts
aiSummary: Hosts file restored to clean state. DNS integrity baseline confirmed.

description: Adversary forces Windows Defender Firewall state to OFF across all profiles.
businessImpact: Endpoint exposed to inbound network worm propagation and exploit scanning.
detectionLogic: FirewallMonitor polled Windows NetSecurity state and caught disabled profile.
attackScript: netsh advfirewall set allprofiles state off && start firewall.cpl

dynamicRecovery.name: Enable All Firewall Profiles
dynamicRecovery.script: netsh advfirewall set allprofiles state on

aiSummary: Host firewall re-enabled across Domain, Private, and Public profiles.

description: Adversary issues command to disable Windows Defender antivirus real-time inspection.
businessImpact: Endpoint antivirus neutralized, allowing execution of unverified binaries.
detectionLogic: DefenderMonitor detected DisableRealtimeMonitoring set to true.
attackScript: powershell -Command "Set-MpPreference -DisableRealtimeMonitoring $true" && start windowsdefender:
aiSummary: Microsoft Defender real-time protection forced back to enabled state.

description: Continuous high-volume data egress simulating intellectual property theft.
businessImpact: Data loss and exfiltration of proprietary credentials.
detectionLogic: HardwareTelemetryService flagged anomalous sustained network buffer transmission.
attackScript: start /b ping -t 8.8.8.8 -l 65500 && start taskmgr
aiSummary: Exfiltration process killed. Outbound socket transmission terminated.

description: Unauthorized interactive command prompt launched by background service.
businessImpact: Interactive shell access for manual adversary reconnaissance.
detectionLogic: ProcessMonitor caught suspicious shell spawn without parent explorer context.
attackScript: start cmd.exe /k "color 4F & title ASTRA_MALICIOUS_SHELL_TEST & echo [ALERT] Malicious CMD Shell Launched! & timeout 15"
aiSummary: Adversary interactive CMD shell terminated cleanly.

description: Creates a hidden directory with system attributes to evade forensic scans.
businessImpact: Staging area for malicious binaries and exfiltrated databases.
detectionLogic: FileSystemMonitor intercepted hidden folder creation under C:\Astra\Demo.
attackScript: mkdir C:\Astra\Demo\HiddenMalware && attrib +h C:\Astra\Demo\HiddenMalware && explorer C:\Astra\Demo
aiSummary: Hidden directory unmasked and purged from local disk storage.

description: Adversary schedules an automated task to maintain persistence across reboots.
businessImpact: Malware re-executes automatically via Windows Task Scheduler.
detectionLogic: ScheduledTaskMonitor detected new task creation targeting non-system binaries.
attackScript: schtasks /create /tn "AstraDemoTask" /tr "calc.exe" /sc onlogon /f
aiSummary: Malicious scheduled task deregistered and removed from Task Scheduler.

description: Drops an executable batch payload designed to disable local security utilities.
businessImpact: Automated execution of adversarial discovery commands.
detectionLogic: FileSystemMonitor caught new .bat creation in temporary directories.
attackScript: mkdir C:\Astra\Demo\Temp && echo timeout /t 10 > C:\Astra\Demo\Temp\malicious.bat && explorer C:\Astra\Demo\Temp
aiSummary: Malicious batch script deleted before execution authorization.

description: Simulates web-tier SQL injection exfiltrating database tables to loopback.
businessImpact: Customer records and hashed credential theft.
detectionLogic: API gateway flagged repetitive union-select exfiltration payload string.
attackScript: echo EXFILTRATED_USERS_DB_DUMP > C:\Astra\Demo\sql_dump.txt && explorer C:\Astra\Demo
aiSummary: SQL exfiltration dump neutralized. Web application sanitization verified.

description: Double-extension spoofed invoice dropper (Invoice_March.pdf.exe) written to disk.
businessImpact: Initial workstation compromise via social engineering attachment.
detectionLogic: FileSystemMonitor flagged executable binary masquerading as PDF document.
attackScript: mkdir C:\Astra\Demo\Downloads && echo FAKE_PAYLOAD > C:\Astra\Demo\Downloads\Invoice_Q3.pdf.exe && explorer C:\Astra\Demo\Downloads
aiSummary: Phishing attachment quarantined and isolated from user desktop.

description: Adversary modifies registry to enable Remote Desktop (fDenyTSConnections = 0).
businessImpact: Inbound remote desktop access permitted without standard bastion controls.
detectionLogic: RDPMonitor polled Terminal Server registry settings and flagged unauthorized opening.
attackScript: reg add "HKLM\System\CurrentControlSet\Control\Terminal Server" /v fDenyTSConnections /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f
aiSummary: Remote Desktop Protocol locked down in Windows registry baseline.

description: Adversary launches credential access tool to extract plaintext passwords from LSASS.
businessImpact: Domain administrator credential compromise and lateral movement.
detectionLogic: ProcessMonitor caught execution of known credential dumper binary signature.
immediateAction: Force-Kill Rogue Process & Protect LSASS Handles
attackScript: start notepad.exe && timeout 1 && echo SIMULATED_MIMIKATZ_LSASS_DUMP > C:\Astra\Demo\lsass.dmp && explorer C:\Astra\Demo
aiSummary: Credential dumper terminated and staged memory dump files purged.

description: Adversary opens a reverse shell listener bound to port 4444 on the endpoint.
businessImpact: Direct command prompt access granted to remote attacking machine.
detectionLogic: NetworkMonitor detected unauthorized TCP port 4444 listening state.
attackScript: start /b powershell -Command "$l = [System.Net.Sockets.TcpListener]4444; $l.Start(); while($true){ Start-Sleep -Seconds 1 }" && timeout 2 && cmd /c netstat -ano | findstr 4444
aiSummary: Reverse shell process terminated and TCP 4444 closed.

description: Continuous high-frequency packet generation flooding the local network interface.
businessImpact: Denial of service, latency spikes, and gateway disconnects.
detectionLogic: HardwareTelemetryService flagged abrupt packet rate surge.
attackScript: start /b ping -t 127.0.0.1 -l 1000
aiSummary: DDoS packet flood process terminated. Network latency returned to baseline.

description: Simulates memory corruption exploit attempting to bypass ASLR and DEP.
businessImpact: Remote code execution in the context of user applications.
detectionLogic: Heuristic memory protection detected repetitive NOP-sled memory allocation pattern.
attackScript: echo ASTRA_HEAP_SPRAY_SIMULATION > C:\Astra\Demo\heap_dump.bin && explorer C:\Astra\Demo
aiSummary: Heap corruption pattern neutralized. Application execution integrity intact.

description: Adversary executes unauthorized XMRig cryptominer driving CPU utilization to 100%.
businessImpact: Endpoint degradation, hardware thermal throttling, and battery drain.
detectionLogic: CPUMonitor flagged persistent maximum thread load without foreground GUI activity.
attackScript: start /b powershell -Command "while($true){ $x = 1 }"
aiSummary: Cryptomining thread force-killed. CPU returned to normal operating temperature.
